name: New England Biolabs Foundation international grants
summary: Small grants for local and grassroots groups that protect ecosystems and the cultural ties people have with them, in a set list of countries in Central America, the Andes and West Africa.

geography.label: Selected countries of Central America, Andean South America and West Africa

reporting: Grantees submit an end-of-project report through the online grant system before the final 20% payment, or an interim report if the project is not finished within the one-year grant period.

eligibility.rule: Holds charitable status in its respective country
Operates on a not-for-profit basis and has a mission to benefit local communities
After a denied proposal, wait one year from its submission before applying again.
Work in one of the foundation’s target landscapes or seascapes within an eligible country.

status.quote: Our 2026 grant round is now closed.

applicant_types.quote: New England Biolabs Foundation grants are limited to organizations that hold charitable status in their respective countries.

access.quote: The first step in the process is to submit a letter of inquiry (LOI) to us, following the guidelines posted here.

window.quote: Our directors meet twice a year to review proposals, and we inform applicants of funding decisions shortly thereafter.

reporting.quote: The foundation must receive your end of project report upon project completion, or an interim report if your project is incomplete by the end of the one-year grant period.

geography.quote: Through our grantmaking, we provide financial support in the form of small project grants to grassroots organizations and other NGOs in selected countries and targeted geographies in Central America, Andean South America, and West Africa.

amount.quote: Our international grants range from $5,000 to $15,000, and our local grants range from $4,000 to $10,000.

effort.quote: The first step in the process is to submit a letter of inquiry (LOI) to us, following the guidelines posted here.
Please do not submit a full proposal without first being invited by our staff to do so.
Our directors meet twice a year to review proposals, and we inform applicants of funding decisions shortly thereafter.

eligibility.quote: New England Biolabs Foundation grants are limited to organizations that hold charitable status in their respective countries.
Eligible organizations must operate on a not-for-profit basis and stand by a mission to benefit local communities.
If we deny your proposal for funding, please wait one year from the date of your original proposal application to submit a new request to us.
Because we are a small foundation, we must limit our grants to specific countries and target landscapes and cannot consider requests from areas outside of our geographic focus.

after_award.quote: The foundation must receive your end of project report upon project completion, or an interim report if your project is incomplete by the end of the one-year grant period.
A report must be submitted at the end of the project when its funding cycle ends and before the final disbursement of grant funds.
